svg.title: Interesting facts about Rajesh
svg.desc: Six highlights: a low-cost robotic hand, an IEEE paper, awards, a mesh network project and a perfect Microsoft score.

g.text: Built a sign language robotic hand
for under $20 with an ESP32, servos
